import html def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML response by safely inserting user-provided content into a predefined template. Parameters ---------- user_input : str Content supplied by the user that will be embedded in the HTML response. Returns ------- str The complete HTML page with the user content safely escaped to prevent script injection. Notes ----- The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize any HTML special characters in the user input. This prevents malicious scripts from being executed when the resulting page is rendered by a browser. """ # Predefined HTML template with a placeholder for user content html_template = """ Safe User Content

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" # Escape the user input to avoid XSS safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Return the final HTML with the escaped content inserted return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
